relationships.subject: allopregnanolone
relationships.evidence_quote: It has been suggested that allopregnanolone alleviated nerve injury- or chemotherapy-induced neuropathic pain

key_findings: Review: neurosteroids act on GABAA, NMDA, sigma-1 receptors and T/L-type calcium channels, and spinal neurosteroidogenesis is increased after nerve injury.
Allopregnanolone has analgesic and neuroprotective effects; neurosteroid effects on seizures depend on site and dose.
